title: TICWATCH PRO ESSENTIAL MODE
symptom: The user asks if there is any way to get readings from xDrip on the Ticwatch Pro in Essential mode, which would be great for battery life.
cause: Essential mode activates the LCD display and is a hardware watchface, and Bluetooth is likely off, so it is not possible to show custom numbers on the LCD.
evidence_quote: I have the TicWatch Pro, essential mode just turns it into a dumb watch, so not possible to show custom numbers on the LCD.
